assessments.reasoning: The document is served by the official WG14 document archive and each page identifies N3220 as a working draft. The editorial cover identifies the post-C23 C2y context. Fresh capture digest bccd974cd9d0227c282c9557e12e29c90df115b403ea4269f58d69661acfc113 binds the full inspected response. The controlling passage is N3220 §6.2.2, Linkages of identifiers, paragraph 3, printed page 36 / PDF page 49. WG14 working draft N3220 assigns internal linkage to a file-scope function identifier declared with the static storage-class specifier. The cited language rule is scoped to the combination of file scope, function identifier, and the static storage-class specifier. The statement describes the specified draft only. It makes no claim about a block-scope declaration, the contents of published ISO/IEC 9899:2024, or any implementation. The same paragraph handles object declarations separately. Neighboring paragraphs distinguish extern and prior declaration effects.
